title: No-Regret Mixing of LRU and LFU with Optimal Switching Cost
abstract: arXiv:2609.07566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Caching systems often rely on simple eviction policies such as Least Recently Used (LRU) and Least Frequently Used (LFU), which perform well in complementary request regimes. Recent policies such as LeCar and Cacheus combine LRU and LFU using ideas from the experts problem in online learning. Specifically, upon a miss, they randomize between the two eviction rules using probabilities derived from scores updated by tracking the history of past evictions. While these policies exhibit strong empirical performance, it remains unclear whether they are guaranteed, on every request sequence, to perform asymptotically as well as the better of LRU and LFU, i.e., whether they achieve sublinear regret with respect to this benchmark. We first show that LeCar suffers linear regret against an oblivious adversary, even with unbounded history. translated_title: 具有最优切换开销的LRU与LFU无遗憾混合策略
translated_abstract: 缓存系统通常依赖于简单的淘汰策略，如最近最少使用（LRU）和最不经常使用（LFU），它们在互补的请求模式下表现良好。诸如LeCar和Cacheus等近期策略借鉴了在线学习中专家问题的思想，将LRU和LFU结合起来。具体而言，在发生缓存未命中时，这些策略使用由追踪历史淘汰记录所更新的分数导出的概率，在两种淘汰规则之间进行随机选择。尽管这些策略展现出强劲的实证性能，但目前尚不清楚它们是否能够在每条请求序列上都保证渐近地表现得与LRU和LFU中较优者一样好，即它们是否能相对于该基准实现次线性遗憾。我们首先证明LeCar在面对遗忘型对手时会遭受线性遗憾，即使拥有无界的历史记录也是如此。随后，我们提出H-MC，一种基于Hedge算法的虚拟LRU与LFU缓存混合策略，该策略保留了Hedge的选择概率特性（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明了现有混合缓存策略LeCar在遗忘型对手下会产生线性遗憾，并提出了一种基于Hedge的虚拟LRU与LFU缓存混合策略H-MC，能够在最优切换开销下实现对LRU与LFU较优者的无遗憾（次线性遗憾）性能保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the existing hybrid caching policy LeCar suffers linear regret against an oblivious adversary, and proposes H-MC, a Hedge-based mixture of virtual LRU and LFU caches that achieves no-regret (sublinear regret) performance against the better of LRU and LFU with optimal switching cost.
